question: Which is the last satellite launched by ISRO in year 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CMS-01.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• CMS-01** (formerly known as GSAT-12R) **could be a communication satellite plan and developed by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
 
• CMS-01 is examined to be a renewal of the aged satellite** GSAT-12.**
 
• It **provides services like tele-education, telemedicine, disaster management support and Satellite Internet access**.
 
• CMS-01 could be a **communication satellite envisaged for providing services in the Extended-C Band of the frequency spectrum**. 
 
• CMS-01 is the **42nd Communication Satellite of India**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **AstroSat** is the first devoted Indian astronomy mission aimed at **studying celestial sources in X-ray, optical and UV spectral bands simultaneously**. ​
 
• **Chandrayaan-2 **is the second lunar exploration mission plan by the Indian Space Research Organisation, after Chandrayaan-1.
 
• Gaganyaan mission would **create 15,000 new employment opportunities**.
